name: "Emergency Barricade"
effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.
description: Valeriy's specialty. A loaf of rye bread so hard it could double as a makeshift rifle rest in a trench, or simply be hurled at an enemy to knock them senseless. Drop it into hot soup, however, and the rich aroma of rye slowly begins to bloom. Once it has soaked up the broth, the rock-hard loaf turns soft, tender, and surprisingly delicious... It is almost miraculous. Even a seasoned army cook might have to admit defeat.
